title: Burial and Cremation Expense Assistance — Larimer County Department of Human Services — 1601 Brodie Ave - Larimer County
summary: Provides financial assistance for burial and cremation services for low-income individuals whose estates are insufficient. The benefit will pay up to $1,500, depending on the decedent's resources at the time of death and total cost of all burial and cremation services.

fields.organization name: Larimer County Department of Human Services
fields.service summary: Provides financial assistance for burial and cremation services for low-income individuals whose estates are insufficient. The benefit will pay up to $1,500, depending on the decedent's resources at the time of death and total cost of all burial and cremation services.
fields.eligibility: The deceased individual must have been a resident of the service area. Additional eligibility requirements may apply. Area Served: Larimer County
fields.access method: Call, walk in, or visit website to begin application process. An application must be turned in within 30 days of death.
fields.required documents: Must provide the following information:   Printout from a bank showing the balance on the date of death of the deceased and/or spouse or provide a letter from a financial institution with the current balance on the date of death  Registration card and mileage for vehicles that are owned or jointly owned by the deceased  Verification of earned or unearned income for the current month (for the deceased)  Copies of all life insurance, burial insurance, or pre-need policies for the deceased, no matter the beneficiary and the surrender value for each policy  Verification of any real estate owned by the deceased, including land, house, or mobile home (if deceased is a minor, must have verification for both parents)  Burial plot purchase information if purchased prior to death  Cash on hand at the time of death for the deceased
fields.hours of operation: Monday - Friday, 8 a.m. - 4:30 p.m.

title: Low-Income Energy Assistance Program (LEAP) — Montezuma County Department of Social Services — 109 W Main - Montezuma County
summary: The Low-Income Energy Assistance Program (LEAP) is a federally funded program that helps eligible Colorado households with a portion of their winter home heating costs. Applications are accepted each year from November 1st - April 30th. The benefit does not cover the full cost of heating and is offered once per season. LEAP payments are made directly to the household’s primary heating fuel vendor or utility. Household types may include those using fuels such as:   Wood   Coal   Propane   Heat billed on a shared meter

fields.organization name: Montezuma County Department of Social Services
fields.service summary: The Low-Income Energy Assistance Program (LEAP) is a federally funded program that helps eligible Colorado households with a portion of their winter home heating costs. Applications are accepted each year from November 1st - April 30th. The benefit does not cover the full cost of heating and is offered once per season. LEAP payments are made directly to the household’s primary heating fuel vendor or utility. Household types may include those using fuels such as:   Wood   Coal   Propane   Heat billed on a shared meter
fields.eligibility: Applicants must:    Be a permanent legal resident of the United States and Colorado, or have a household member that is a US citizen   Pay home heating costs to a heating provider, fuel dealer, or landlord as part of rent   Have a maximum household income that falls within the guidelines below    'Household” means people who live with you and for whom you are financially responsible. fields.access method: Apply online. Visit the website to download a paper application and drop off at the local DHS office or mail/email to the county to process. Call to request a mailed paper application, to apply over the phone, or for more information.
fields.required documents: Must provide:    Proof of citizenship if born outside of the US   Proof of all monthly household income    If self-employed, receipts for all expenses claimed on profit and loss statement   Copy of most recent heating bill or recent rent receipt, if heat is included with rent
fields.hours of operation: Monday - Friday, 8 a.m. - 5 p.m. (Administrative Hours)
